### Safe Internet
- Wi-Fi with a sign-in page (hotels, airports, cafés) now works: Safe Internet steps aside so the sign-in page can load, and comes back on its own once you are online. - If Kahf's filter cannot be reached but the internet works, your Mac switches to Cloudflare's family filter, so you stay online and adult and malware sites stay blocked. It returns to Kahf automatically. - Home and the menu bar show "Paused" while this is happening, and the menu bar has a Retry button. - On a Mac where changing the filter is locked (by your organisation or by you), the network's own unfiltered DNS is used for at most 30 minutes a day. After that it uses Cloudflare's family filter if it can; otherwise the internet stays off until Kahf can be reached, and Home says so.
